AGPL-3.0 is OSI-approved but imposes strong network copyleft: any modified version running on a publicly accessible server must offer corresponding source to users (section 13). This creates significant compliance obligations for commercial/proprietary deployments. The pyproject.toml classifier 'License :: OSI Approved' is generic and does not specify AGPL. No COPYING, NOTICE, or alternative license files were found. The three package manifests (extension/package.json, ui/package.json, workflows/pyproject.toml) contain no license field. Status is REVIEW because AGPL-3.0 requires legal assessment for any non-open-source distribution or SaaS use.
